entities.summary: Franco Petri Burgersdijk, or Franciscus Burgersdicius, was a Dutch logician who worked as a professor of logic and moral philosophy and rector at Leiden University. Franco Burgersdijk's teaching helped raise the profile of logic and philosophy in Dutch universities.
